routes.title: Routes
routes.description: IATA route pairs like JFK-LHR, SFO-NRT, LHR-JFK. Three letter airport codes separated by a dash. One row per airline option on each route and date.

departureDates.title: Departure dates
departureDates.description: ISO dates like 2026-05-15. Leave blank to use departDaysAhead and dateWindowDays for a rolling window.

returnDates.title: Return dates
returnDates.description: Optional return dates aligned with departureDates. Leave blank for one way searches.

departDaysAhead.title: Depart days ahead
departDaysAhead.description: Used when departureDates is blank. Starts the rolling window this many days from today.

dateWindowDays.title: Date window (days)
dateWindowDays.description: Used when departureDates is blank. Number of consecutive days to scan starting at departDaysAhead.

tripType.title: Trip type
tripType.description: one_way or round_trip. round_trip uses return dates if provided, otherwise adds 7 nights to each departure.

passengers.title: Passengers
passengers.description: Number of adult passengers. Price per the whole party.

maxStops.title: Max stops
maxStops.description: 0 for nonstop only, 1 for up to one stop, 2 for any itinerary. Default 2.

maxPriceUsd.title: Max price ($)
maxPriceUsd.description: Drop fares above this. Use with a daily schedule for price drop alerts.

minPriceUsd.title: Min price ($)
minPriceUsd.description: Drop fares below this. Useful to filter out error fare noise.

preferredAirlines.title: Preferred airlines
preferredAirlines.description: IATA airline codes like BA, DL, UA, LH. Keeps only flights operated by listed carriers. Leave empty for all.

excludeAirlines.title: Exclude airlines
excludeAirlines.description: IATA airline codes to drop. Useful to avoid a carrier you never book.

maxItemsPerRoute.title: Max items per route
maxItemsPerRoute.description: Cap on fares pushed per route and date combination. Google Flights typically lists 8 to 15 options.

maxItemsTotal.title: Max items per run
maxItemsTotal.description: Hard cap on rows per run. Controls cost.

dedupe.title: Deduplicate across runs
dedupe.description: Skip fares seen on previous runs. Turn off to build your own price history dataset.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy. Residential recommended for hourly schedules.
